title: 第19章 抢人大战复活赛第20章 抢人大战绝杀
slug: 这个主角明明很强却异常谨慎
content_zh:
“唰唰唰……”
数道破空声响起。
刚刚离去的三位峰主急匆匆归来。
“呦呦呦……我说三位，怎么又回来了。”
红娘嘴角含笑。
瞅着急匆匆归来的三位峰主，忍俊不禁。
“事情忙完肯定要回来，十年一度招收弟子这么大的事，怎么能少了我。”
云鼎脸不红心不跳，一屁股坐在自己的位置上。
精光闪烁的眸子，不住上下打量郑拓。
看的郑拓浑身难受，本能的紧了紧衣领。
“你们俩呢。”
红娘看向云千里与雷刑。
“我和云师兄一个想法，自家孩子，怎么能冷落让孩子寒心。”
云千里的脸皮厚度不比云鼎差。
红娘摇头，看向雷刑。
“咳咳……”
雷刑是好面儿的人。
不像云鼎跟云千里那样脸皮厚。
“师妹你看我干啥，我刚刚就是去解个手而已，你不会以为我真走了吧，哈哈哈……哈哈……哈……咳咳……”
如此话语，惹来几人白眼。

堂堂金丹期修士，饭都不用吃，你还解手。
上坟烧报纸，糊弄鬼呢。
几个老家伙非常不要脸。
说是走，其实一直都有关注。
见极品灵根出世，老脸都不要也要回来搏一搏。
极品灵根者，若能收为徒弟，他们这一脉必将崛起。
未来，肯定还需要这个徒弟提携。
弄好了，躺进仙路不是梦。
“极品灵根？”
郑拓不傻。
上学时修仙小说还是看过不少。
极品灵根，灵根中的航空母舰。
如果别人一天的修行是一条小溪。
那么他一天的修行就是整个太平洋。
如果别人一天的修行是一片雪花。
那么他一天的修行就是珠穆朗玛峰上的雪崩。
如果别人一天的修行是一滴雨水。
那么他一天的修行就是末日下的狂风暴雨。
总的来说，就是特别特别特别屌，特别牛叉的存在。
金手指有点大啊！

郑拓十分苦恼。
他本想低调行事，一步一个脚印来修仙。
现在有极品灵根，以后怕是免不了麻烦。
“郑拓，自我介绍一下，我名为云鼎，仙鼎峰峰主，金丹期后期修士，炼丹之术已入化境，加入我仙鼎峰，别的不敢说，丹药随便你吃，以你的天赋，不出百年，元婴可期。”
云鼎抢先一步与郑拓搭讪。
content_en:
"Shuashuashua..."
Several sounds broke through the air.
The three peak masters who had just left returned in a hurry.
"Yo yo yo... I said three of you, why are you back again?"
The matchmaker smiled.
Looking at the three peak masters returning in a hurry, they couldn't help laughing.
"I will definitely come back when I'm done with my work. Recruiting disciples is such a big deal once every ten years, so how can I be left out?"
Yunding's face didn't turn red, and his heart didn't beat. He sat down in his seat.
His shining eyes kept looking at Zheng Tuo up and down.
Zheng Tuo felt uncomfortable watching this and instinctively tightened his collar.
"Where are you two?"
The matchmaker looked at Yun Qianli and Lei Xing.
"Senior Brother Yun and I have the same idea. How can we neglect our own children and make them feel cold?"
Yun Qianli's face is no worse than Yunding's.
The matchmaker shook her head and looked at Lei Xing.
"Ahem..."
Lei Xing is a good-looking person.
Not as shameless as Yunding and Yun Qianli.
"Junior sister, look at what I'm doing. I just went to relieve myself. You don't think I'm really leaving, hahaha...haha...ha...ahem..."
Such words made several people roll their eyes.
A dignified monk in the golden elixir stage, you don't even need to eat, and you still relieve yourself.
Go to graves and burn newspapers to fool ghosts.
A few old guys are very shameless.
Although he said he was leaving, he was always paying attention.
Seeing the birth of the best spiritual root, even if you don't want to be old, you will come back and give it a try.
If those with the best spiritual roots can be accepted as disciples, their lineage will surely rise.
In the future, this apprentice will definitely be needed to support him.
Once it's done, it's no longer a dream to lie down on the immortal road.
"The best spiritual root?"
Zheng Tuo is not stupid.
I read a lot of novels about cultivating immortals when I was in school.
The best spiritual root, the aircraft carrier among spiritual roots.
If someone else’s daily practice is like a stream.
Then his one day of practice covers the entire Pacific Ocean.
If someone else’s daily practice is like a snowflake.
Then his day's practice is like an avalanche on Mount Everest.
If someone else's daily practice is like a drop of rain.
Then his day's practice is like a violent storm at the end of the world.
In general, it is a very, very, very bad, and very awesome existence.
Goldfinger is a bit big!
Zheng Tuo was very distressed.
He originally wanted to keep a low profile and cultivate immortality step by step.
Now that I have the best spiritual roots, I am afraid that I will inevitably be in trouble in the future.
"Zheng Tuo, please introduce yourself. My name is Yunding. I am the master of Immortal Cauldron Peak. I am a late-stage Golden Elixir monk. My alchemy skills have reached the realm of transformation. Join me at Immortal Cauldron Peak. I dare not say anything else. You can take the elixirs as you like. With your talent, you can expect to have Nascent Soul within a hundred years."
Yunding was the first to strike up a conversation with Zheng Tuo.
